findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: update_cart, get_ar_visualizer_url · Private data: get_order, get_whatsapp_handoff · Public sink: create_quote_link, update_cart, create_checkout, complete_checkout, cancel_checkout, get_delivery_estimate, request_price_match · Destructive: lookup_catalog, update_cart, cancel_cart.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: update_cart, get_ar_visualizer_url · Private data: get_order, get_whatsapp_handoff · Public sink: create_quote_link, update_cart, create_checkout, complete_checkout, cancel_checkout, get_delivery_estimate, request_price_match · Destructive: lookup_catalog, update_cart, cancel_cart

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_delivery_estimate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
